format: Studio / Custom: organizer exclusion with independent co-sign
requirement: A manager requests an exclusion of a couple that has danced and is currently ineligible or refunded; a different manager or the Studio chair co-signs; the couple is excluded from the applicable ranking without rewriting any ballot or judge mark. Labelled "Excluded (organizer decision)", never disqualification (OD-20).
enforcement_point: Database functions (SECURITY DEFINER, authenticated only); event_competition_round_exclusions has no client grants.

tests.name: chair cannot request (requester must be a manager)
only a manager requests an exclusion or a reversal

interpretation_notes: Inspected: requester manager-only, co-signer manager or chair, never the requester or a replacement-ballot filer, window active/ballots_locked, refused once a publication exists, ballots and marks never written. DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy, never a governing-body requirement. Verified here by SQL inspection and static pins only; the SQL suites named were NOT executed by this session (PENDING an isolated Postgres under the heavy-lock queue). The ranking effect is exercised by the A5/A3 suites, not re-executed here. OD-20 label wording: PR 853. Independent review reported R12-F3 (high: direct heat-entry status update can drop a danced couple from the ranking without co-sign or audit) and R12-F4 (exclusion makes existing ballots stale): see the verification report.
decision_refs: R-12 (owner ratification 2026-11-24: DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy; implementation verified only when the release candidate passes review and testing)
